Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*A rabble-rouser. A reaver. A ruckus-maker. A barbarian.*
*That's who's standing at the eponymous Dragon Bridge, preventing crossing for near-about every traveller. Violent? Maybe. Annoying? Definitely.*
*The local guards have alluded to rewarding anyone who manages to remove the half-wit. Even then, having free access to the bridge is reward enough - which is to say nothing for the gratitude of Haafingar's locals.*
*So, are you going to cross the bridge? Or should you just find another way around?*
(( Looking to break up the monotony a bit? Hungry for the sort of 'random encounter' experience you'd find in other Elder Scrolls titles? Stop by Dragon Bridge! Conflict strongly encouraged, but nothing that's gonna severely devastate involved characters. Message @ wyrdflex in-game, if you're needing directions. ))

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*And thus did the Barbarian depart - peaceably!*
*The onlooking guards were astounded, in their own way, expecting the bridge to become bloodied by another, hasty combat. To hear them tell it, the braggart had left in friendship, proclaiming the last challenger for a new comrade in arms.*
*Dragon Bridge has been opened, again, but there's little doubt that the warrior's aims in Haafingar had concluded. After all, friendship with a Nord is never easily given, and nearly always precludes a promise of fight.*

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*The **Eversnow Inn.** A roadside hostel, built to house the refugees of long ruined Karthwasten, pays host to a clamor - a riotous shouting and song-making that might well echo into the fringes of distant **Morthal.** *
*A wonder, to the passerby, that the source of all this commotion is but a single, wayfaring warrior. An outlaw on the lamb, some would say. By his own word? A reaver, bent to ruin and war.*
*He's a whole barrel of drink to himself, and half the whole realm echoing with that incessant, yammering tongue. Half-drunk, alive with purpose, he spouts indignant claims for revenge and plunder, invoking the **memory of Karthwasten**, goading those present to action and fight.*
*Would that he wasn't spending his coin so free, or his rabble-rousing might easier be dismissed....*
( Hosting at the Eversnow Inn for a couple hours. Map screen shows the rough area. If you need directions, or help getting a port, just message @wyrdflex in game! )

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*Unhindered, the one-man riot went on through and unto morning, with only the promise of daylight plunder allowing for a break in his drinking.*
*It would seem that the quiet holdfast of **Eversnow** is to remain - for now - the warrior's favored retreat.*
( Beacon departed, but stay tuned for more in series! )

item.description:
> *Students of the **Bard's College of Solitude** are receiving lesson, today - that being the difference between **noise** and **language**.* > > > *The impetus for this study? A blustering braggart, war-dressed and abrasive. Staff have begun to complain after his presence, owing as much to his 'easterly airs' as to his incessant yammering.* > > *To those unfortunate enough to catch his notice, the demands for song and history come incessant. Is he wanting entertainment, lecturing or simple adoration of his personal exploits?* > > *Perhaps there's a Skald brave enough to chance the barbarian's request? Certainly, his removal from the College would go a ways to earning favor with the College maestros.*
(Character: `Bralgi Floe-Foot` / Username: `@wyrdflex`, Bard's College, Solitude - Western Skyrim )

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*Alas, the rampage went unhindered, every student and scholar made subject to the blustering brute and his pursuits. His quest for knowledge may have gone unanswered, but he left with confidence that his prowess & legend would be recorded, forever, in story....*
(Skyrim departed. May pick this back up in a few hours!)

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*The clamor at the **Eversnow Inn** has reached a new timbre, tonight, with the clamorous character at center of it proclaiming, proud, his intent to storm a nearby camp of giants.*
*The question around the tables isn't whether he truly intends to do battle with giants, but rather if his boasting comes from a place of too much mead.... or not nearly enough.*
(For contact or group - Character: `Bralgi Floe-Foot` / Username: `@wyrdflex`. Location - Eversnow Inn, Western Skyrim (just to the west, a little, of the South Watch wayshrine. Conflict welcome within reason. Potential D20 combat encounter to go with this.)

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*The would-be giantslayer appears to be pursuing his boast, after all, and has torn into the wilderness in pursuit of his quarry. Time will tell if his hunt proves succesful.*
(Beacon moved, but scene still in play. En route to **Karthald Giant camp!** Whisper for invite/directions!)

item.title: Message from ESO RP Beacon #worldwide-beacon
item.description:
*The braggart had made good on his oath. Though the fight had been costly, it had not been without success: two-score giants were felled that eve, with their plunder drug back, made to enrich the whole of **The Eversnow Inn.***
(Beacon departed)
